blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–There was a humbling tone in the voice of Magnolia coach LA Tenorio as his rookie season came to a close in a rough way with a quarterfinal sweep at the hands of TNT. And Tenorio knows that there are plenty of things to work on before he can find himself among the elite coaches of the league. “Madami pa din akong kakainin na bigas (I still have a lot to learn),” Tenorio admitted after the Hotshots’ 98-87 loss to the TNT Tropang 5G that eliminated them from the season-ending PBA Governors’ Cup.
